title: ASD-STE100 plugin
description: Enforce the ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English specification in Limatus as a first-class rule-set plugin alongside the existing bot-slop diagnosis heuristics. As a technical-publication operator, I want Limatus to check drafts against ASD-STE100 (controlled vocabulary, one meaning per word, sentence-length limits, one instruction per sentence, active voice, imperative procedures, no -ing forms, article rules), so that procedure and description text is verifiably STE-compliant before publication. Planning only: specs and gold examples come first per The Way; no implementation in this pass.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Initiative complete: all six epics landed (scaffolding, vocabulary, writing rules, procedure-vs-description handling, evals/gold corpus, CLI/docs) across Epics 1-6. Final suite: 198 pytest passed, 34 behave features / 113 scenarios passed, offline evals 6/6 and STE gold 5/5 with precision=1.0000 recall=1.0000.
